name: Protein Without Meat
instructions: Lean on legumes (lentils, chickpeas, black beans), tofu, tempeh, and edamame as your main plant protein sources.
Combine grains with legumes over the course of a day (rice + beans, hummus + pita) to cover all essential amino acids.
Press and marinate tofu before cooking -- it absorbs flavor far better once excess water is removed.
Watch today's video for meal ideas built around a solid protein source, then swap in a plant-based one.
